title: Country Miler 2026 routes locked in
excerpt: Mark your calendars: The Country Miler returns on Polk County country roads (not the Highline) with 60-mile and 23-mile options starting at First Baptist Church Bolivar. Three SAG stops, tacos at the finish, and every dollar supports Alpha House. Register on BikeReg.
